title: Harbor Mutual Claims Service Terms for Trip Protection
content:
Every Trip Protection plan is underwritten by Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company, whose claims team decides trip protection claims. The claims terms below are set plan by plan.

## Claims terms by plan

| Plan | Claim must be submitted within (calendar days after the loss) | Claims team decides within (business days) | Several benefits may be claimed on one policy | Insurer |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Cancellation Only | 90 | 15 | yes | Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company |
| Trip Protection Essential | 90 | 15 | yes | Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company |
| Trip Protection Standard | 90 | 15 | yes | Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company |
| Trip Protection Plus | 90 | 15 | yes | Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company |
| Trip Protection Premier | 90 | 10 | yes | Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company |
| Trip Protection Premier CFAR | 90 | 10 | yes | Harbor Mutual Travel Insurance Company |

## Terms common to every plan

- **What a claim must carry:** proof of the covered reason, the Roamhaven receipt and refund statement.
- **How benefits are paid:** by direct deposit or check to the insured guest.

## Basis questions

**How long does the claims team take to decide?** Within 15 business days on Trip Cancellation Only, Trip Protection Essential, Trip Protection Standard and Trip Protection Plus, and within 10 business days on Trip Protection Premier and Trip Protection Premier CFAR. The decision period is counted in business days; the filing period is counted in calendar days.

**May a guest claim more than one benefit on a single policy?** Yes; on every plan several benefits may be claimed on one policy.

**To whom is a benefit paid?** To the insured guest, by direct deposit or check.
